title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - ProductStock
description: ProductStock is a base class for defining a product (or configured product with values characteristic) stock level. (TM Forum TMF687 Stock Management 4.0.0, Swagger definition ProductStock; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:ProductStock:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ProductStock'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF687_StockManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF687-Stock-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductStock/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:ProductStock:<tmfId>. Unique identifier of the ProductStock

creationDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF687_StockManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF687-Stock-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductStock/properties/creationDate'. Date when the ProductStock was created (whatever its status).

description.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF687_StockManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF687-Stock-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductStock/properties/description'. Free-text description of the ProductStock

lastInventoryDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF687_StockManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF687-Stock-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductStock/properties/lastInventoryDate'. Last inventory count date for this ProductStock.

lastUpdate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF687_StockManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF687-Stock-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductStock/properties/lastUpdate'. Last date when the ProductStock record was updated.

replenishmentDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF687_StockManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF687-Stock-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductStock/properties/replenishmentDate'. Planned date for future replenishment for this ProductStock.

channel.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF687_StockManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF687-Stock-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductStock/properties/channel'. The channel to which the resource reference to. e.g. channel for selling product offerings, channel for opening a trouble ticket etc..

marketSegment.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF687_StockManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF687-Stock-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductStock/properties/marketSegment'. provides references to the corresponding market segment as target of a product stock. A market segment is grouping of Parties, GeographicAreas, SalesChannels, and so forth.

maxStockLevel.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF687_StockManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF687-Stock-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductStock/properties/maxStockLevel'. An amount in a given unit

minStockLevel.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF687_StockManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF687-Stock-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductStock/properties/minStockLevel'. An amount in a given unit

place.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF687_StockManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF687-Stock-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductStock/properties/place'. Used to define a place useful for the ProductStock for example a geographical place where the Product Stock is located

productStockLevel.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF687_StockManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF687-Stock-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductStock/properties/productStockLevel'. An amount in a given unit

productStockRelationship.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF687_StockManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF687-Stock-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductStock/properties/productStockRelationship'. relationship to other product stock

productStockStatusType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF687_StockManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF687-Stock-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductStock/properties/productStockStatusType'. The status of the ProductStock, such as available, unavailable, reserved, unknown

productStockUsageType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF687_StockManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF687-Stock-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductStock/properties/productStockUsageType'. The usage type of the ProductStock, such as inTransit, damaged, onDisplay, etc..

relatedParty.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF687_StockManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF687-Stock-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductStock/properties/relatedParty'. A list of related party references (RelatedParty [*]). A related party defines party or party role linked to a specific entity

reorderQuantity.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF687_StockManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF687-Stock-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductStock/properties/reorderQuantity'. An amount in a given unit

resource.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF687_StockManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF687-Stock-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductStock/properties/resource'. The Resource managed through this ProductStock is used. In TMF this is an array of ResourceRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced Resource entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Resource:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

stockLevelAlert.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF687_StockManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF687-Stock-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductStock/properties/stockLevelAlert'. An amount in a given unit

stockedProduct.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF687_StockManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF687-Stock-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductStock/properties/stockedProduct'. Product stocked in this product stock - could be via a productSpecification, a ProductSpecification + valued characteristic, etc. In TMF this is a ProductRefOrValue object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced Product entity (urn:ngsi-ld:Product:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF687_StockManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF687-Stock-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductStock/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF687_StockManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF687-Stock-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ProductStock/properties/@schemaLocation'.
